How to play

Collect cyan crystals and slay dragons for more.
Twelve dragon types on the main island, plus three unique kinds on every floating island, each with its own power. Touch the boss dragon (follow the golden beacon) to start a turn-based battle with your spells.
The castle in the center is a safe zone: dragons cannot enter and you heal there. You also slowly regenerate and earn crystals passively.
Defeated dragons have a 20% chance to drop an egg: incubate it (inventory, Dragons tab) and ride the hatched dragon to reach the floating islands. Wildlife is peaceful: nobody can hurt it. Beware the pterodactyls: they hunt you while you ride your dragon, but cannot touch you on the ground.
Every island has its own dragons and boss. Beat an island boss to raise the next island.

Sometimes the Heavens open: you are lifted above the clouds to face a giant angel and her winged host.

Hell Rifts open on the main island now and then: step into one to fight three waves of demons. Demons have a 10% chance to drop a skull. With 3 skulls you can open a portal to Hell and face its lord from the sky.

Spend crystals to roll abilities, wizard robes and capes. Eight rarities from Common to Godly: rarer means stronger.

On a phone or tablet: your left thumb moves, drag on the right side to look around, pinch to zoom, and use the on-screen buttons to jump, attack, cast and roll. Spells fire at the centre circle.

Every control is in Settings: press Esc or the ⚙ button at any time to see them, change key bindings, and adjust sound, camera and graphics.
